nodes.name: Ebda Store Three Product Render Paths
nodes.description: Ebda Store storefront has three distinct product-card rendering surfaces (StorefrontProductCard, per-theme ProductCard x5, ProductCarousel) — all 7 files must be updated together for any platform-level product UX change, or the fix is incomplete.

nodes.name: StorefrontProductCard.tsx
nodes.description: Shared pack-aware product card used on PLP (/products), /search, and /categories/[slug] — pack-agnostic structure with per-pack className via pack-styles.ts.

nodes.name: Theme ProductCard.tsx (5 files)
nodes.description: Per-theme pack-opinionated product cards (modern, elegant, classic, minimal, bold) — each owns its own card layout and is used by T.ProductGrid for theme identity on collection grids.

nodes.name: ProductCarousel.tsx
nodes.description: Horizontal-scroll homepage carousel component rendering 'New Arrivals' and 'Best Sellers' strips — the silent third render path that bypasses both StorefrontProductCard and theme ProductCard.

nodes.name: ProductCardCta.tsx (shared)
nodes.description: Canonical shared CTA component accepting hasVariants, viewHref, inStock — the single source of truth for product-card call-to-action that all three render paths should import rather than inlining button JSX.

nodes.name: Partial Product Card Fix (Path 3 Omission)
nodes.description: Updating StorefrontProductCard + theme ProductCards without updating ProductCarousel leaves the homepage broken — commit ca8b4ed demonstrated this trap when variant-aware CTA was missing from the carousel.

nodes.name: Commit ca8b4ed — Partial CTA fix (missed path 3)
nodes.description: Initial platform CTA commit that fixed paths 1 and 2 but missed ProductCarousel (path 3) — left homepage without variant-aware CTA.

nodes.name: Commit 33abdf6 — Path 3 + RTL select fix
nodes.description: Fixed ProductCarousel (path 3) after Ahmad re-flagged missing variant CTA on homepage; also applied RTL select min-w fix for Arabic truncation on PLP toolbar.

nodes.name: Ebda Store Mobile Header Storefront Spec
nodes.description: Standing mobile header pattern for all 5 Ebda Store themes: Row 1 = hamburger + h-24 centered logo + actions; Row 2 = always-visible persistent search bar (not toggleable). Target reference: demo-store.example mobile.

nodes.name: Centered Logo Absolute Positioning Pattern
nodes.description: Use `absolute left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2` on the logo Link with max-w-[55%] guard — parent flex justify-between then correctly bookends hamburger and actions without fighting the centered child. Do NOT nest inside a fixed-width container.

nodes.name: Anti-pattern: Toggleable Mobile Search Bar
nodes.description: Hiding the search bar behind a toggle on mobile hurts discoverability — the demo-store target spec requires the search bar always-visible (persistent) on mobile. Toggle stays desktop-only.

nodes.name: Anti-pattern: Small Mobile Logo (h-16)
nodes.description: Shrinking logo to h-16 on mobile for 'compact' reasons violates the demo-store spec — Ahmad explicitly requires h-24 (96px) as the floor for wordmark logos like demo-store.

nodes.name: Commit 873bc7d — Mobile header propagated to 4 remaining themes
nodes.description: Second commit in the mobile header batch: propagated the demo-store mobile header spec (h-24 logo, persistent search row) from modern theme to elegant, classic, minimal, and bold.

nodes.name: Ebda Store RTL Select Min-Width Pattern
nodes.description: Arabic Select labels in horizontal toolbars truncate without explicit min-w because Arabic option text is longer than English equivalents and RTL connected-script glyphs need more pixel width. Fix: min-w-[12rem] for Sort, min-w-[6rem] for Show, stack until lg: (not sm:).

nodes.name: Anti-pattern: sm: Breakpoint for Toolbar Next to Sidebar
nodes.description: Using sm: to switch a PLP toolbar to single-row puts it in flex-row layout while the lg: sidebar is still squeezing the products column — worst case for truncation. Must match the sidebar's own lg: breakpoint.

nodes.name: Rule: Select Components Require Arabic-Width min-w
nodes.description: Every Select in apps/web/src/app/**/*Client.tsx must have an explicit min-w-[Nrem]; Selects with only flex-1 sm:flex-initial and no min-w are truncation time-bombs in Arabic locale.

nodes.name: iOS No-Zoom 16px Floor (cross-file reference)
nodes.description: text-base (16px) on mobile form inputs and Select triggers prevents iOS Safari forced-zoom on focus — referenced by both the mobile header spec (search input) and the RTL select pattern (select trigger). See global feedback-mobile-form-text-base.

nodes.name: Platform-Level Fix Propagation Rule
nodes.description: Ahmad's standing rule: any product UX, header, or UI fix must propagate to all themes and all render paths — not just the one tested. Operationalized by the 7-file grep check for product cards and the 5-theme propagation requirement for headers.
